B1+ English Listening Test

Listen to four people talk about their experiences living abroad. For questions 1 to 8, choose the correct answer.
See the full list of B1+ listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: Andrew's landlord sent him an apology letter.
Erica wasn't the typical Brit when she first arrived in Brazil.
Now, Erica has to make an effort when she's in England.
April went to Vietnam because she wanted to change her life.
April talks about what happens to the people who visit her.
For Scott, wildlife is the most remarkable thing about Kenya.
Back home, Scott once had to wait hours to receive road assistance.
